汪汪队立大功儿童安全救援故事书
雪山救生员
美国尼克儿童频道／著
安东尼／译
天地出版社｜TIANDI PRESS

[P2] 今天的天气真好，汪汪队正准备去看望冰原上的好朋友杰克。
这时，一辆大卡车疾驰而来，停在队员们面前。莱德自豪地介绍说：“看，这是最新款汪汪巡逻车！它也是咱们的移动塔台，可以带着我们去任何地方！”
正说着，车门开了，一只机器狗蹦蹦跳跳地跑了出来。
莱德继续说：“这只机器狗是我们的司机罗博！”

[P3] 莱德带领着队员们走进巡逻车参观，杰克刚好打来了电话。
“嘿，杰克，冰原那边的情况怎么样啊？”莱德问道。
“棒极了！你们瞧！”杰克指着身后开心地说。
屏幕上出现了一座美丽的雪山和一条晶莹的冰河。

杰克突然在冰面上滑倒了，他大叫着：“我的手机！我的地图！我的包包！”
糟糕，杰克所有的装备全都掉进了冰河里。

[P4] “杰克有麻烦了！”小砾大声说。
“狗狗们，行动起来！”莱德命令道。
巡逻车的后门打开，降下了一道斜坡。狗狗们迅速坐上自己的交通工具，罗博发动引擎，巡逻车准备出发了。
冰原上，杰克努力想要抓住掉进冰河里的背包，但是河岸上到处都是冰，杰克眼看就要滑进河里了。幸运的是，一只哈士奇在紧要关头冲过来拉住了他。
“感谢你救了我！”杰克很激动地向狗狗介绍了自己。
狗狗开心地说：“我叫珠珠，我做到了！我一直梦想成为一名真正的救生员！”

[P5] 珠珠说道：“我们得赶快离开这里，暴风雪马上就要来了，我可不想我的第一次救援工作会失败。咱们先到冰屋中躲一下吧！来，像我这样，我们很快就能到那儿！”

珠珠低下身子，用肚皮贴着雪地，从雪山上“嗖”地滑了下去。
“肚皮滑雪板！”杰克兴奋地叫道。他紧跟着珠珠也滑了下去。
“当心下面！”珠珠喊道。
两个新朋友就这样沿着雪坡快乐地滑行着，他们的身旁时不时闪过一些好奇的企鹅。

[P6] 巡逻车到达冰原时，雪已经下得很大了。狗狗们立刻开始搜寻起杰克来。很快，他们就找到了已经结冰的手机和背包。
莱德担心地说：“这说明杰克身上没有任何装备。”
突然，他在雪地上发现了一些东西：“那是脚印吗？”
阿奇马上跑过去闻了闻：“是杰克的脚印，他身边还有一只狗狗！”
莱德说道：“这些脚印能带领我们找到杰克！大家都跟上！”

[P7] 阿奇负责在地面上跟踪脚印，天天驾驶着直升机穿行在风雪中。

这时，杰克和珠珠来到一座又高又窄的冰桥边。“桥对面就是我的冰屋。”珠珠说道。
杰克担心地问：“这座小桥能撑得住我们俩吗？”
“但愿吧！这是唯一一条可以通过的路。”珠珠回答。
他们小心翼翼地往前走时，突然听到一声可怕的巨响，冰桥裂开了！

[P8] 杰克和珠珠眼看就要掉进山谷里了。这时，天上突然垂下来一根绳索，杰克和珠珠赶紧抓牢。
这是天天驾驶着直升机赶来营救他们了！
就在天天拉着他们往山谷对岸飞去时，绳索突然断了！
“赶紧跳！”杰克大喊。
珠珠成功地跳到了对岸，可是杰克却没来得及上岸，他拼命抓牢崖壁。
“不要慌！我抓着你呢！”珠珠大喊。只见她紧紧地咬着杰克的衣袖，使劲把他拖了上来。
“太好啦，我又救了你一次！”

[P9] 天黑了，所有人都安全地聚在杰克的山间小屋，一份惊喜在等着大家——香喷喷的烤棉花糖！

杰克说：“珠珠，我可以邀请聪明勇敢的你当我的助手，守卫这片雪山吗？”

莱德补充道：“还得负责保护杰克，以及营救其他遇险的人呢！你愿意加入我们汪汪队吗？”

“哇哦，这真是我生命中最棒的一天！”珠珠高兴地叫着，其他狗狗也跟着一起欢呼起来。
full_text_en:
[P1] nickelodeon
PAW
PATROL
Paw Patrol: Children's Safety Rescue Storybook
Mountain Rescue
By Nickelodeon Children's Channel
Translated by Anthony
Tiandi Press

[P2] The weather is great today. The Paw Patrol is preparing to visit their good friend Jack on the ice field.
At this moment, a big truck speeds up and stops in front of the team. Ryder proudly introduces: "Look, this is the latest Paw Patrol vehicle! It's also our mobile command center, which can take us anywhere!"
Just then, the door opens, and a robot dog蹦蹦跳跳地 runs out.
Ryder continues: "This robot dog is our driver, Robo!"

[P3] Ryder led the team into the patrol vehicle for a tour, just as Jake called in.
"Hey, Jake, how's it going over at the ice field?" Ryder asked.
"Great! Look!" Jake pointed behind him, smiling happily.
On the screen appeared a beautiful snowy mountain and a sparkling ice river.

Jake suddenly slipped on the ice and shouted, "My phone! My map! My backpack!"
Oh no, all of Jake's gear had fallen into the ice river.

[P4] "Jack is in trouble!" Rubble shouted.
"Pups, let's go!" Ryder commanded.
The patrol vehicle's rear door opened, lowering a ramp. The pups quickly hopped into their vehicles, Robo started the engine, and the patrol vehicle was ready to go.
On the ice field, Jack struggled to grab his backpack that had fallen into the icy river. But the riverbank was covered in ice, and Jack was about to slip into the river. Luckily, a husky rushed over at the last moment and grabbed him.
"Thank you for saving me!" Jack excitedly introduced himself to the pup.
The pup happily said, "My name is Zuzu. I did it! I've always dreamed of becoming a real lifeguard!"

[P5] Zhu Zhu said, "We need to leave here quickly. The blizzard is coming soon, and I don't want my first rescue mission to fail. Let's take shelter in the ice house first! Come on, like this, and we'll get there in no time!"

Zhu Zhu lowered her body, pressed her belly against the snow, and slid down the mountain with a "whoosh!"
"Belly snowboard!" Jack exclaimed excitedly. He followed Zhu Zhu down the slope.
"Watch out below!" Zhu Zhu shouted.
The two new friends happily slid down the snowy slope, with curious penguins occasionally flashing by their sides.

[P6] When the patrol vehicle arrived at the ice field, the snow had already started falling heavily. The pups immediately began searching for Jack. Soon, they found Jack's phone and backpack, which had frozen over.
Ryder worriedly said, "This means Jack didn't have any gear with him."
Suddenly, he spotted something on the snow: "Are those footprints?"
Chase rushed over and sniffed, "They're Jack's footprints, and there's a dog with him!"
Ryder said, "These footprints can lead us to Jack! Everyone, follow me!"

[P7] Chase is tracking footprints on the ground, while Skye flies her helicopter through the blizzard.

At this moment, Jake and Everest arrive at a tall, narrow ice bridge. "The other side is my ice house," Everest says.
Jake worries, "Can this little bridge hold both of us?"
"Hopefully! It's the only way through," Everest replies.
As they carefully move forward, they suddenly hear a terrifying crash—the ice bridge cracks open!

[P8] Jake and Zuma were about to fall into the valley. Suddenly, a rope dropped from above, and Jake and Zuma grabbed it quickly.
This was天天 driving the helicopter to rescue them!
Just as天天 was pulling them toward the other side of the valley, the rope suddenly broke!
"Jump quickly!" Jake shouted.
Zuma successfully jumped to the other side, but Jake hadn't made it yet. He desperately clung to the cliff.
"Don't panic! I've got you!" Zuma shouted. She tightly bit Jake's sleeve and pulled him up with all her strength.
"Great! I've saved you again!"

[P9] It was dark, and everyone was safely gathered in Jack's mountain cabin, with a surprise waiting for them—delicious roasted marshmallows!

Jack said, "Zuma, I can invite you, brave and clever, to be my helper and guard this snowy mountain, right?"

Ryder added, "You'd also be responsible for protecting Jack and rescuing other people in danger! Would you like to join our Paw Patrol?"

"Wow, this is the best day of my life!" Zuma cried happily, and the other pups cheered along with her.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《汪汪队立大功儿童安全救援故事书》的封面，标题为《雪山救生员》，展示了角色 Chase 和 Everest，以及背景中的雪山和小主人，由美国尼克儿童频道著、安东尼译，天地出版社出版。
[P2] 汪汪队在莱德的带领下，准备出发去冰原看望朋友杰克，莱德介绍了新装备——汪汪巡逻车和机器狗司机罗博。
[P3] 莱德和队员们在巡逻车内通过屏幕与杰克通话，杰克在冰原上展示美景时突然滑倒，所有装备掉入冰河。
[P4] 本页左侧描绘莱德和小砾在巡逻车旁准备出发，右侧描绘杰克在冰原上险些滑入冰河，被哈士奇珠珠及时救下，珠珠实现了成为救生员的梦想。
[P5] 珠珠和杰克在雪山上用肚皮滑雪的方式滑行，珠珠提醒杰克注意下方，他们沿途遇到了一些好奇的企鹅。
[P6] 汪汪队抵达冰原后，发现雪下得很大，他们找到了杰克被冻住的手机和背包，莱德担心杰克没有装备。随后，阿奇发现杰克的脚印，并确认旁边有一只狗，莱德决定循着脚印寻找杰克。
[P7] 阿奇在地面追踪脚印，天天驾驶直升机在风雪中飞行；与此同时，杰克和珠珠来到一座狭窄的冰桥边，珠珠表示桥对面是她的冰屋，杰克担心桥能否承重，珠珠安慰说这是唯一通道，但当他们前行时，冰桥突然裂开。
[P8] 杰克和珠珠在冰原上险些坠入山谷，天天驾驶直升机前来救援，但绳索突然断裂。珠珠跳到对岸后，用牙齿咬住杰克的衣袖，将他从悬崖边救了上来。
[P9] 在杰克的山间小屋，大家围坐在篝火旁，杰克和莱德邀请珠珠加入汪汪队，珠珠兴奋地接受了邀请，其他狗狗也一同欢呼庆祝。
